# Swiss typography — Style Prompt

> International Typographic Style in motion: the frame is a spread on a 12-column grid, a programme on the left page (a header row, a grey lead-in over a bold statement, a giant step numeral, tiny technical notes) and an artifact on the right page (a white paper on its own module grid) that obeys each rule the moment it is announced. Flat page, ink, light greys and one signal colour; every element snaps to the grid on the beat, nothing bounces, and the one element that breaks the system becomes the character.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

- **Pure 2D graphic design animated on a grid**: a flat page, black type and bars, two or three light greys and **one** saturated signal colour.
- **A spread**: the left page is the programme (cause), the right page is the artifact (effect). Each step announces a rule on the left with a giant numeral and a short statement; the paper on the right changes accordingly in the same bar.
- **Every element snaps to the grid, every move lands on a beat, nothing bounces.** Entrances are clip-reveals and wipes, exits are the same upward or a knife cut, never a fade.
- **Rigor with one exception**: the whole frame obeys a system, so the one element that does not (unsnapped, linear, tilted, the only thing in the signal colour) becomes a character.
- **Extreme scale contrast**: a numeral 660 px tall next to 21 px notes.

Not a stage talk (no gradients, glow or device renders), not kinetic typography for a lyric video (words never fly, spin or bounce), not data visualisation (bars and rules have mass as graphic form unless the grid gives them a meaning), not a Bauhaus pastiche of primary shapes, and never a copy of a specific historical poster (no concentric-circle or fan layouts).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Frame grid** (1920×1080): 12 columns of 122 px, 24 px gutters, 96 px side margins, so columns start at `96 + n·146`. Paper and numeral sit 36 px from the top and bottom edges; notes run on a 26 px baseline.
- **Column bands**: while the system is being established (the opening and the first rule) the 12 columns are drawn as flat bands a few percent darker than the page, gutters and margins left bare. They collapse once the grid is taken for granted.
- **Header row**: a 3 px grey rule across six columns (x 96-948, y 34); below it 21 px notes at the starts of columns 1, 3 and 5 (the series, the step "1 / 3", the topic of the step).
- **Left page**: lead-in at y 134, statement at y 178 (column 1); the giant numeral flush left on the bottom margin (baseline y 1042, cap height about 660 px), inside a clip box that ends at the margin, so overshoots are cut flat; a notes block at column 5 under a 3 px rule at y 960 (three 21 px lines: module sizes, counts); a tempo marking and a bar counter at column 7.
- **Right page**: a paper (x 1118-1824, y 36-1044, columns 8-12), flat, no shadow, a hairline edge only so it holds on a pale page. Its own grid, inset 34 px: 7 columns × 16 rows of 91 × 40 px modules in 2 px light-grey lines, then seven baseline rules below without verticals. The artifact's lines are centred on it, big name at the top, smaller lines on the rows below.
- **Choose module sizes that give elements mass**; too many thin columns make a layout look like a chart. What the artifact grid means is a design decision (millimetres of a stamp, hours of a day, floors of a building).
- **Surfaces only**: page, paper, ink, signal, greys. No gradients, shadows, particles or grain. Bars and rules are flat boxes; cells of one unit merge into one bar, overdrawn 1 px at seams.
- **A secondary voice**: light-grey elements under the black ones (bands, grid lines, rules) give depth without a second colour.
- **Camera**: one 2D matrix (centre, scale, rotation) on a wrapper; the reference spread stays locked.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the page (#eae9e5 in the film's own colours); `--latar-2` is the paper (#ffffff), the artifact's surface. With a dark brand the paper becomes a lighter panel of the same hue, keeping the step.
- `--teks` is the ink: statements, the title, giant numerals, the artifact's lines. `--teks-redup` carries lead-ins, the tempo marking and readouts.
- `--utama` is **the one signal colour**, given to one thing at a time: the signal rule of the opening (a line on the page, so drawn as `--utama-di-latar`) and, at the end, the exception: a solid `--utama` block with `--teks-di-utama` type on it (overprint is allowed: ink-on-signal). Its "off grid" word is `--utama-di-latar`.
- `--aksen` and `--aksen-di-latar` are **not drawn**: this look has one signal colour. Never add a second, even when the brand has an accent.
- Greys are mixed from the contract so they follow any brand: column bands 4% ink into the page, rules 42% ink into the page, paper grid 13% ink into the paper, the knife 72% ink into the paper, the paper's hairline 6%.
- The source's signal options were red (#e30613), orange (#ff5a00), ultramarine (#1f3fff) or green; choose for the topic, then never add another. On a pale brand whose main colour does not read on the page, the rule falls back to ink and the exception block keeps the brand colour.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the giant numerals (Archivo Black 940 px, −0.03em, line height 0.72 so the baseline sits on the box bottom for any font) and the opening title (112 / 106 px, −0.025em, two lines flush left). Heavy neo-grotesques suit it: Archivo Black, Inter 800.
- `--font-isi` carries everything else: statements Inter 600 at 72 / 84 px (−0.02em); lead-ins Inter 400 at 30 px in `--teks-redup`; header notes 600 at 21 px; technical notes 400 at 21 / 26 px; the bar counter 600. On the artifact, after the "one typeface" rule, all lines are lowercase in this family: the name 800 at 112 px, key lines 600 at 40-54 px, secondary lines 400 at 30-52 px.
- The source asks for one neo-grotesque family in several weights; with the bundled fonts Archivo Black and Inter stand in as one voice. Letter-spacing about −2% at 90 px and up; headlines may be lowercase.
- **Flush left, ragged right**, everything on a column start, big white space as part of the layout. Giant numerals are **optically** flush left: subtract the glyph's left bearing (Archivo Black: "1" 0.094em, "2" 0.047em, "3" 0.031em, "4" 0.016em).
- **Statements are part of the layout**, not subtitles: a small grey lead-in ("Langkah satu.") over a large bold statement, each word clip-revealed on its own beat, held at least max(1.8 s, reading time + 0.6 s).
- The artifact's "before" state may mix bundled display faces (Playfair Display, IM Fell English, Special Elite, Caveat, Limelight) to show disorder; that is content, not brand.
- Notes at 21 px are texture. Whatever the viewer must read (name, contact, price) goes in the statement or the giant numeral. A wider brand font: keep a statement line under about 18 characters.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Two curves only**: a precise `cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)` for every snap (the timeline core takes it as an ease function: solve the bezier for x, return y), and linear for lines being drawn, counters and the exception. No overshoot, no spring, no bounce.
- **Tempo 120**: a beat is 0.5 s, a bar 2 s. Snaps last a note value (0.2-0.35 s) and land on a beat; a step takes about 3.3 s (6-7 beats).
- **Words** rise from 130% below the baseline inside a clip mask in 0.25 s, one every 0.2-0.25 s; they leave upward the same way, 0.02 s apart. Masks carry 0.2em of padding for descenders.
- **The giant numeral** climbs one module at a time: three eased steps of 0.2 s (104 → 69 → 35 → 0% of its height); it drops out downward in 0.35 s while the statement leaves upward.
- **Lines grow along their length**, linear: the signal rule crosses 1920 px in 0.45 s, then retracts from its far end into the paper in 0.4 s; grid verticals 0.5 s each, 0.07 s apart, from the top; horizontals 0.3 s each, 0.035 s apart, from the left; baseline rules 0.05 s apart.
- **Paper** appears by a wipe from the top in 0.3 s (precise).
- **Re-set** (before/after): each line's old version leaves upward as its new one rises 0.1 s later, lines 0.09 s apart top to bottom.
- **Knife cut**: a 3 px line crosses the element and overhangs it (0.2 s linear); 0.05 s after it lands the element collapses to its midline (0.25 s precise) with the knife.
- **Re-flow**: survivors move to their new rows, 0.35 s precise, nearest to the change first, 0.06 s apart.
- **Ripples are ordered by distance** from their cause: the column bands collapse to their midlines 0.035 s apart starting at the side nearest the paper.
- **The exception moves differently**: linear and unsnapped, pausing mid-flight (0.3 s, a 0.12 s stop, 0.28 s), landing tilted (−4°) and off the grid, with a readout that says so.
- Counters tick with the timeline (the bar counter per beat, lines removed per cut); everything stops for the ending, which holds still for 2 s or more.

## 6. Camera grammar

A vocabulary, not a route. The camera moves only with the precise ease and only on beats; transitions are wipes, knife cuts, camera moves and re-flows, never dissolves. The example keeps a locked spread throughout.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked spread | cause (left) → effect (right) | a rule applied; a before/after; a comparison |
| Hard pan by one page or column | the next step in a system | a sequence; a catalogue; a timeline |
| Rotate 90° and stop | the same thing read another way | a poster as a score; a chart as a map |
| Pull out to a wall of artifacts | one programme, many outputs | a brand system; a product range; a series |
| Push into one module | detail; the unit of the system | a letter; a single data point; one product |
| Grid extends past the page | the system is bigger than the artifact | scale; ambition; a break from constraints |
| Split frame into equal cells | parallel cases | options; variants; team members |
| Vertical scroll through a column | reading; a list | a manifesto; a spec sheet; a timetable |

Framing: everything sits on the grid; the signal element may sit off it only while it is being the exception. Rotate, hold, then add labels.

## 7. Native moves

- **Programme.** Rules announced one by one on the left, each applied at once to one artifact on the right; later the same programme can generate many. *Fits content like:* a stamp maker setting a shop's stamp in three steps; a creator's thumbnail rules; a teacher's three rules for a lab report; a brand identity being built.
- **Snap = beat.** Every arrival is a hit on the tempo: words one per beat, lines of the artifact one per eighth. *Fits content like:* a product's feature list; the steps of a recipe; the order of a ceremony; a countdown to a launch.
- **Extreme scale contrast.** A giant numeral as the chapter card, or as the price, beside 21 px notes that give its unit. *Fits content like:* a step number; a record statistic; "45" with "ribu rupiah" below; the year a family business opened.
- **Re-set.** The same artifact before and after, each line swapping into one typeface from top to bottom. *Fits content like:* a messy menu made calm; a student's slide cleaned up; a creator's old channel banner; an invitation redone.
- **Knife cut.** An element deleted by a line that crosses it, then collapses to its midline. *Fits content like:* removing the clutter from a label; cutting a step from a workflow; a budget line struck; a chapter dropped from a story.
- **Re-flow.** Everything else moves to its new row around a change, nearest first. *Fits content like:* a stamp layout closing up after cuts; a team chart reorganised; a timetable after a cancelled class; a page adapting to a phone.
- **The exception.** One element breaks the grid: linear, unsnapped, tilted, the only thing in the signal colour, with a readout "di luar grid". *Fits content like:* the printed stamp landing crooked; the inventor in a story; an outlier in the data; the one product that does not follow the rules.
- **The grid means something.** Columns and rows become a quantity (millimetres, hours, floors, years). *Fits content like:* a stamp face in 7 × 3 mm modules; a week's opening hours; a building's floors; a course's sessions.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Too many thin columns look like a chart: use fewer, wider modules.
- A "better" composition that is not obviously better: one strong diagonal with long/short rhythm, a larger signal element, bleeds, type over colour. Merely tilting is not enough.
- Rotating and labelling at once reads as noise: rotate, hold, then add labels.
- Merged bars show seams after rotation or scale: overdraw 1 px.
- Clip masks: hide words at 130% of their height, not 110%; ascenders of a tightly leaded headline peek into the descender padding otherwise. Keep each mask one word (or one line) so a wider brand font cannot reflow a live line.
- Two signal elements at once kill the signal. Only the exception (and its own readout) carries `--utama`.
- Header notes are short: at 21 px a note longer than a column pair runs into the next one.
- Onsets that fall between frames flicker: put visual onsets on whole frames (multiples of 1/30 s).
- Performance: draw the grid once (a few dozen divs) and animate only `scale`, `yPercent` and clip-path; no filters, no shadows, no per-frame redraws. Counters write text only when it changes.
- A pale brand: the paper and the page are both near white, so the paper keeps its hairline edge and its grid; check the signal rule, which falls back to ink.

## Variation space

You decide the system, what the grid means, the exception (or none), the signal colour, the opening and the ending.

- Structures: **a timetable** (a 24-row grid of hours fills with the topic's day, one row per beat); **an alphabet** (A to Z, each letter a module of the topic, completing as a specimen sheet); **a comparison** (two systems side by side on a split spread until one element crosses the gutter).
- Openings: **a single dot** placed on the page, then the grid growing from it; **the finished artifact**, then dismantled into its rules; **a giant numeral** filling the frame that turns out to be a detail of a small layout.
- Endings: **the empty grid** after every element has been cut away; **a single word** flush left in the corner; **the exception leaves the frame** and the system closes over the space it left.

# Swiss typography: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2, medium 3, long 4.

## hook

- en: the title rises word by word flush left, one signal-colour rule is drawn across the frame, a blank paper wipes in on the right
- id: judul naik kata demi kata rata kiri, satu garis warna sinyal ditarik melintang, kertas kosong disapu masuk di kanan

## problem

- en: the paper shows the mess: lines in mixed faces and sizes, off the grid; a grey note names what is wrong
- id: kertas memperlihatkan kekacauan: baris berhuruf dan berukuran campur, keluar grid; catatan abu-abu menyebut salahnya

## fact

- en: a grey lead-in and a bold statement rise beside a giant numeral; tiny technical notes appear under a 3 px rule
- id: pengantar abu-abu dan kalimat tebal naik di samping angka raksasa; catatan teknis kecil muncul di bawah garis 3 px

## step

- en: the step numeral climbs one module at a time, the rule rises word by word, and the paper on the right obeys it
- id: angka langkah memanjat per modul, aturannya naik kata demi kata, dan kertas di kanan langsung menurutinya

## compare

- en: the same paper before and after: each line is re-set in one typeface, top to bottom, one beat apart
- id: kertas yang sama sebelum dan sesudah: tiap baris disusun ulang ke satu jenis huruf, dari atas ke bawah

## number

- en: the figure as a giant numeral flush left at the bottom margin, climbing in steps; tiny notes give its unit
- id: angkanya jadi angka raksasa rata kiri di margin bawah, memanjat bertahap; catatan kecil menyebut satuannya

## proof

- en: notes count what changed (lines removed, white space %) while the finished paper holds still on its grid
- id: catatan menghitung yang berubah (baris dihapus, persen ruang kosong) sementara kertas jadi diam di gridnya

## offer

- en: a knife line crosses the old price, it collapses to its midline, and the new price rises into the same row
- id: garis pisau melintasi harga lama, harga itu runtuh ke garis tengahnya, harga baru naik di baris yang sama

## cta

- en: name and contact flush left beside a giant price; the one signal-colour element lands linear and off-grid, held 2 s
- id: nama dan kontak rata kiri di samping harga raksasa; satu unsur warna sinyal mendarat miring di luar grid, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: everything is cut away but one word flush left in the corner of the empty grid, held 2 s
- id: semua dipotong habis kecuali satu kata rata kiri di sudut grid yang kosong, diam 2 detik

      // Satu kurva presisi cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1) untuk semua snap; garis yang digambar dan pengecualian linear.

        let a = 0, b = 1, s = t;
        for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
          s = (a + b) / 2;
          const x = 3 * (1 - s) * (1 - s) * s * x1 + 3 * (1 - s) * s * s * x2 + s * s * s;
          if (x < t) a = s; else b = s;
        }
        return 3 * (1 - s) * (1 - s) * s * y1 + 3 * (1 - s) * s * s * y2 + s * s * s;
      };
      const P = bez(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1);
      const $ = (sel, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll(sel)];
      const el = (cls, css, parent) => {

      for (let j = 0; j <= 16; j++) gh.push(el("gh", { top: 33 + j * 40 + "px" }, grid));
      for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) gb.push(el("gh", { top: 711 + k * 40 + "px" }, grid));

      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Masuk = naik dari masker; keluar = naik ke atas; angka raksasa memanjat tiga modul, lalu jatuh.
      const rise = (t, at, d = 0.25, each = 0) =>

      const climb = (t, at) => {
        tl.fromTo(t, { yPercent: 104 }, { yPercent: 69, duration: 0.2, ease: P }, at);
        tl.to(t, { yPercent: 35, duration: 0.2, ease: P }, at + 0.2);

        rise($(".lead .w", s), t0 + o.lead);
        words.forEach((w, i) => rise(w, t0 + o.kata + i * o.jarak));
        rise($(".nt .w", s), t0 + o.catatan, 0.25, 0.1);
        if (tEnd) {
          leave([...$(".hn .w", s), ...$(".lead .w", s), ...words, ...$(".nt .w", s)], tEnd - 0.45);
          drop($(".num", s), tEnd - 0.45);

      leave([...$("#s1 .hn .w"), ...judul], 1.95, 0.03);

        rise(n, 7.6 + i * 0.09);

      // Adegan 4 (8,7-12 s): tiga potong pisau, tiap baris runtuh ke garis tengahnya; sisanya pindah, terdekat dulu.

      const jam = { t: 0 };

      tl.to(jam, {

    <script>
      // Satu kurva presisi cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1) untuk semua snap; garis yang digambar dan pengecualian linear.
      const bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => (t) => {
        let a = 0, b = 1, s = t;
        for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
          s = (a + b) / 2;
          const x = 3 * (1 - s) * (1 - s) * s * x1 + 3 * (1 - s) * s * s * x2 + s * s * s;
          if (x < t) a = s; else b = s;
        }
        return 3 * (1 - s) * (1 - s) * s * y1 + 3 * (1 - s) * s * s * y2 + s * s * s;
      };
      const P = bez(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1);
      const $ = (sel, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll(sel)];
      const el = (cls, css, parent) => {
        const d = document.createElement("div");
        d.className = cls;
        Object.assign(d.style, css);
        parent.appendChild(d);
        return d;
      };

      // Grid digambar sekali: kolom halaman, lalu grid kertas 7 kolom × 16 baris plus 7 garis dasar di bawahnya.
      const kolom = $("#kolom")[0], grid = $("#grid")[0];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) el("kol", { left: 90 + i * 154 + "px" }, kolom);
      const gv = [], gh = [], gb = [];
      for (let i = 0; i <= 7; i++) gv.push(el("gv", { left: 33 + i * (638 / 7) + "px" }, grid));
      for (let j = 0; j <= 16; j++) gh.push(el("gh", { top: 33 + j * 40 + "px" }, grid));
      for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) gb.push(el("gh", { top: 711 + k * 40 + "px" }, grid));

      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Masuk = naik dari masker; keluar = naik ke atas; angka raksasa memanjat tiga modul, lalu jatuh.
      const rise = (t, at, d = 0.25, each = 0) =>
        tl.fromTo(t, { yPercent: 130 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: d, ease: P, stagger: each }, at);
      const leave = (t, at, each = 0.02) => tl.to(t, { yPercent: -130, duration: 0.25, ease: P, stagger: each }, at);
      const climb = (t, at) => {
        tl.fromTo(t, { yPercent: 104 }, { yPercent: 69, duration: 0.2, ease: P }, at);
        tl.to(t, { yPercent: 35, duration: 0.2, ease: P }, at + 0.2);
        tl.to(t, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: P }, at + 0.4);
      };
      const drop = (t, at) => tl.to(t, { yPercent: 104, duration: 0.35, ease: P }, at);
      const grow = (t, at, d, origin = "0% 50%") =>
        tl.fromTo(t, { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: d, ease: "none", transformOrigin: origin }, at);

      // Anatomi satu bab (adegan 2-5): kepala, angka, pengantar, kata pernyataan per ketukan, catatan; keluar di akhir.
      function bab(id, t0, tEnd, o = { lead: 0.5, kata: 0.75, jarak: 0.2, catatan: 1.25 }) {
        const s = $(id)[0];
        const words = $(".st .w", s);
        rise($(".hn .w", s), t0 - 0.15, 0.25, 0.08);
        climb($(".num", s), t0 + 0.1);
        rise($(".lead .w", s), t0 + o.lead);
        words.forEach((w, i) => rise(w, t0 + o.kata + i * o.jarak));
        rise($(".nt .w", s), t0 + o.catatan, 0.25, 0.1);
        if (tEnd) {
          leave([...$(".hn .w", s), ...$(".lead .w", s), ...words, ...$(".nt .w", s)], tEnd - 0.45);
          drop($(".num", s), tEnd - 0.45);
        }
      }

      // Adegan 1 (0-2,25 s): kata judul tiap seperempat ketukan, garis sinyal ditarik linear, kertas disapu dari atas.
      const judul = $("#s1 .ttl .w");
      judul.slice(1).forEach((w, i) => rise(w, 0.25 + i * 0.25));
      grow("#sig", 0, 0.45);
      tl.fromTo("#kertas", { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 100% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.3, ease: P }, 1.1);
      tl.set("#kertas", { clipPath: "none" }, 1.41);
      tl.to("#sig", { scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: "100% 50%", duration: 0.4, ease: "none" }, 1.45);
      leave([...$("#s1 .hn .w"), ...judul], 1.95, 0.03);
      rise("#namaA", 2.1);

      rise(["#tempo", "#birama"], 2.25, 0.25, 0.08);
      tl.fromTo(gv, { scaleY: 0 }, { scaleY: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "none", stagger: 0.07 }, 2.4);
      tl.fromTo(gh, { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "none", stagger: 0.035 }, 2.9);
      tl.fromTo(gb, { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "none", stagger: 0.05 }, 3.55);

      tl.to(".kol", { scaleY: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: P, stagger: { each: 0.035, from: "end" } }, 5.45);
      bab("#s3", 5.5, 8.75);
      const lama = $(".ln .o"), baru = $(".ln .n");

      baru.forEach((n, i) => {
        leave(lama[i], 7.5 + i * 0.09, 0);
        rise(n, 7.6 + i * 0.09);
      });

      // Adegan 4 (8,7-12 s): tiga potong pisau, tiap baris runtuh ke garis tengahnya; sisanya pindah, terdekat dulu.
      bab("#s4", 8.7, 12);
      const potong = [9.95, 10.4, 10.85];
      ["#b3", "#b6", "#b8"].forEach((b, i) => {
        grow(b + " .kn", potong[i], 0.2);
        tl.to(b, { scaleY: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: P }, potong[i] + 0.25);
      });
      [["#b7", -160], ["#b5", -66], ["#b4", -54]].forEach(([b, dy], i) =>
        tl.to(b, { y: dy, duration: 0.35, ease: P }, 11.3 + i * 0.06));

      // Adegan 5 (12-15 s): harga raksasa, kontak; cap merah masuk linear, berhenti sejenak di tengah jalan, mendarat miring.
      bab("#s5", 12, 0, { lead: 0.1, kata: 0.25, jarak: 0.1, catatan: 0.3 });
      tl.to("#nr5", { scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: "100% 50%", duration: 0.25, ease: "none" }, 11.75);
      leave(["#tempo", "#birama"], 11.75, 0.05);
      grow("#nr7", 12, 0.25);
      tl.fromTo("#cap", { x: 760, y: -70, rotation: 0 }, { x: 350, y: -32, rotation: -1.8, duration: 0.3, ease: "none" }, 12.05);
      tl.to("#cap", { x: 0, y: 0, rotation: -4, duration: 0.28, ease: "none" }, 12.47);
      rise("#s5 .rd .w", 12.65);

      // Penghitung (bergerak hanya mengikuti waktu timeline): birama per ketukan, jenis huruf, baris dihapus, ruang kosong.
      const jam = { t: 0 };
      const tulis = (id, s) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e.textContent !== s) e.textContent = s; };
      tl.to(jam, {
        t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none",
        onUpdate() {
          const t = Math.min(jam.t, 11.75);
          tulis("birama", `birama ${String(Math.floor(t / 2) + 1).padStart(2, "0")}.${Math.floor((t % 2) / 0.5) + 1}`);
          tulis("jenis", `Jenis huruf ${jam.t >= 8 ? 1 : 5}`);
          const n = potong.filter((p) => jam.t >= p + 0.3).length;
          tulis("hapus", `Baris dihapus ${n}`);
          tulis("ruang", `Ruang kosong ${[38, 46, 53, 61][n]} %`);
        },
      }, 0);

      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
